taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: Every provider operation declares cost class, quota-unit cost, reset policy, batch capability, minimum candidate stage, reserve eligibility, and `STRICT_FREE` permission.
`STRICT_FREE` blocks paid, unknown-cost, overage, automatic-upgrade, and paid-fallback operations.
Protected reserves exist for risk monitoring, alert verification, interactive MCP, and emergency backfill.
Broad scans degrade breadth/depth before consuming protected quota.
Provider calls are batch-coalesced where supported and exact-cache/single-flight precede quota reservation.
Cost forecasts use current verified provider plan metadata and observed usage.
Blocked cost operations are audited with candidate, caller, reason, and alternative behavior.
Paid data-provider mode requires a separate immutable policy, explicit budget, approval, activation, and re-authentication.
